reports.title: Inspire Medical Systems, Inc. Announces Third Quarter 2026

guidance.heading: Full Year 2026 Guidance
section: The Company is narrowing its previously announced revenue outlook to be in the range of $850 million to $860 million, compared to the previous range of $835 million to $875 million. Additionally, the Company now expects adjusted operating margin to be in the range of 4.5% to 5.5%, diluted EPS to be in the range of $(0.36) to $(0.10) and adjusted diluted EPS to be in the range of $1.20 to $1.40.

The Company’s outlook assumes an effective tax rate of approximately 120% to 175% and an adjusted effective tax rate of 33% to 34%, estimated weighted average diluted shares outstanding of approximately 28.9 million, and capital expenditures between $35 million to $40 million.
